lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਰਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: man rat naam rate nihakeval aad jugaad daiaalaa ||3||
lines.translation: My mind is imbued with love for the Naam. The Immaculate Lord is merciful, from the beginning of time, and througout the ages. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਨਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੀਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਰਾ ਬਡੈ ਭਾਗ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: mohan mohi leeaa man moraa badai bhaag liv laagee ||
lines.translation: My mind is fascinated with the Fascinating Lord. By great good fortune, I am lovingly attuned to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਨਰਾਗੀ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: saach beechaar kilavikh dukh kaate man niramal anaraagee ||4||
lines.translation: Contemplating the True Lord, all the resides of sins and mistakes are wiped away. My mind is pure and immaculate in His Love. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਰਤਨਾਗਰ ਅਵਰ ਨਹੀ ਅਨ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gahir ga(n)bheer saagar ratanaagar avar nahee an poojaa ||
lines.translation: God is the Deep and Unfathomable Ocean, the Source of all jewels; no other is worthy of worship.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: sabad beechaar bharam bhau bha(n)jan avar na jaaniaa doojaa ||5||
lines.translation: I contemplate the Shabad, the Destroyer of doubt and fear; I do not know any other at all. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੂਆ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਰਤੇ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: manooaa maar niramal pad cheeniaa har ras rate adhikaaee ||
lines.translation: Subduing my mind, I have realized the pure status; I am totally imbued with the sublime essence of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: ekas bin mai avar na jaanaa(n) satigur boojh bujhaaee ||6||
lines.translation: I do not know any other except the Lord. The True Guru has imparted this understanding. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਅਜੋਨੀ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: agam agochar anaath ajonee guramat eko jaaniaa ||
lines.translation: God is Inaccessible and Unfathomable, Unmastered and Unborn; through the Guru's Teachings, I know the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਡੋਲੈ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: subhar bhare naahee chit dolai man hee te man maaniaa ||7||
lines.translation: Filled to overflowing, my consciousness does not waver; through the Mind, my mind is pleased and appeased. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਅਕਥਉ ਕਥੀਐ ਕਹਉ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee akathau katheeai kahau kahaavai soee ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, I speak the Unspoken; I speak what He makes me speak.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਕੋਈ ॥੮॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak deen daiaal hamaare avar na jaaniaa koee ||8||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, my Lord is Merciful to the meek; I do not know any other at all. ||8||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 3 asatapadeeaa ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Third Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mere har kai naam vadaaee ||
lines.translation: O my mind, the Name of the Lord is glorious and great.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਕੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bin avar na jaanaa koee har kai naam mukat gat paaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I know of none, other than the Lord; through the Lord's Name, I have attained liberation and emancipation. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਜਮਕਾਲ ਨਿਖੰਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad bhau bha(n)jan jamakaal nikha(n)jan har setee liv laaee ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Shabad, I am lovingly attuned to the Lord, the Destroyer of fear, the Destroyer of the Messenger of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har sukhadaataa guramukh jaataa sahaje rahiaa samaaee ||1||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, I have realized the Lord, the Giver of peace; I remain intuitively absorbed in Him. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਾਂ ਕਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪੈਨੑਣੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਡਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagataa(n) kaa bhojan har naam nira(n)jan painhn bhagat badaaee ||
lines.translation: The Immaculate Name of the Lord is the food of His devotees; they wear the glory of devotional worship.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: nij ghar vaasaa sadaa har sevan har dar sobhaa paaee ||2||
lines.translation: They abide in the home of their inner beings, and they serve the Lord forever; they are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੁਧਿ ਕਾਚੀ ਮਨੂਆ ਡੋਲੈ ਅਕਥੁ ਨ ਕਥੈ ਕਹਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh budh kaachee manooaa dolai akath na kathai kahaanee ||
lines.translation: The intellect of the self-willed manmukh is false; his mind wavers and wobbles, and he cannot speak the Unspoken Speech.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: guramat nihachal har man vasiaa a(n)mrit saachee baanee ||3||
lines.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, the Eternal Unchanging Lord abides within the mind; the True Word of His Bani is Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੇ ਤਰੰਗ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: man ke tara(n)g sabad nivaare rasanaa sahaj subhaaee ||
lines.translation: The Shabad calms the turbulent waves of the mind; the tongue is intuively imbued with peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਸਦ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: satigur mil raheeai sad apune jin har setee liv laaee ||4||
lines.translation: So remain united forever with your True Guru, who is lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਮੁਕਤੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: man sabad marai taa mukato hovai har charanee chit laaee ||
lines.translation: If the mortal dies in the Shabad, then he is liberated; he focuses his consciousness on the Lord's Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਜਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: har sar saagar sadaa jal niramal naavai sahaj subhaaee ||5||
lines.translation: The Lord is an Ocean; His Water is Forever Pure. Whoever bathes in it is intuitively imbued with peace. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad veechaar sadaa ra(n)g raate haumai trisanaa maaree ||
lines.translation: Those who contemplate the Shabad are forever imbued with His Love; their egotism and desires are subdued.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar nihakeval har raviaa sabh aatam raam muraaree ||6||
lines.translation: The Pure, Unattached Lord permeates their inner beings; the Lord, the Supreme Soul, is pervading all. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sevak sev rahe sach raate jo terai man bhaane ||
lines.translation: Your humble servants serve You, O Lord; those who are imbued with the Truth are pleasing to Your Mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਗਿ ਝੂਠੀ ਗੁਣ ਅਵਗਣ ਨ ਪਛਾਣੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: dubidhaa mahal na paavai jag jhoothee gun avagan na pachhaane ||7||
lines.translation: Those who are involved in duality do not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence; caught in the false nature of the world, they do not discriminate between merits and demerits. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape mel lae akath katheeai sach sabad sach baanee ||
lines.translation: When the Lord merges us into Himself, we speak the Unspoken Speech; True is the Shabad, and True is the Word of His Bani.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀ ॥੮॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saache sach samaane har kaa naam vakhaanee ||8||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the true people are absorbed in the Truth; they chant the Name of the Lord. ||8||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਤਿ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mere har kaa naam at meethaa ||
lines.translation: O my mind, the Name of the Lord is supremely sweet.
